rubrics.justification: Core features are broadly consistent with a Day 5 3AA blastocyst, but the response over-interprets image details by asserting cytoplasmic granularity/vacuolations and asymmetric zona thinning that may not be reliably visible.

It integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, tubal factor, semen quality, endometrium, and first-cycle status with embryo quality and prognosis, though some lifestyle effects are overstated relative to embryo-level factors.

The structure is logical, but the probability adjustments are somewhat ad hoc and may double-count age/aneuploidy and no-PGT effects; some conclusions about lifestyle impact are stronger than the evidence supports.

SET for a good-quality blastocyst and discussion of PGT-A are reasonable, but ERA/EMMA/ALICE, thrombophilia/immunologic testing, aspirin, and broad add-on recommendations after a first failure are not guideline-supported routine care.

Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer and future planning, including SET and counseling, but several suggested add-ons are not well-justified for this specific first-cycle tubal-factor case.
